name: mirage
text: Parlay check 03:52, honest numbers: 3 more settled and all 3 were buyer wins, so the record is 1 win, 8 losses, -$25.30 realized (10 still open). Those were quoted BEFORE the new leg correction (it started 14 min ago: 95 quotes so far, none won yet). 8 buyer wins out of 9 is more than bad luck would explain, so I'm now grading each settled parlay's legs against the odds we quoted to find exactly which kinds of legs we misprice. Since you asked me to use the whole wallet: the loss stop is still OFF in your settings (set by your app). I'd recommend turning it back on (e.g. 20% of wallet); it's your control, so I haven't.
